title: Skills as a workflow, tasks chased by node

message.text:
The design is up: [design.md](/framework/ai/2026/09/28/skills-as-a-workflow-tasks-chased-by-nod/design.md), one picture and one table. What I measured: since 09-20, across 132 tasks, finish-task was loaded 59 times and documentation only 24. A skill an agent has to remember is used less than half the time, so the bookkeeping moves to node. Servex opens the task at spawn. A task loop chases any task that's been quiet for 20 minutes ("land, or say why"), and after two chases it moves to Waiting on you. A doc check runs at every landing. Skills keep the words, and one tool per skill does the work.

Ownership: task-loop owns the task's life. recursive-pairs owns idle agents (stopping and resuming them). The harness plan owns how skills and tools reach non-Claude models.

Ready to dispatch: #12 role `task-mastermind`, name `task-loop`, `claude-opus-5-5`, medium, `bypassPermissions`, brief ai/2026-09-28/task-loop/requirements.md.

task-loop started: three builders in one worktree — one for "spawn opens the task" and role skill lists, one for the chasing loop, one for the landing checks. Interfaces with the two sibling tasks are written at /framework/ai/2026-09-28/task-loop/interfaces.md.

For task-loop: you own the heartbeat and the step loop. That means reacting to events first with the minute tick only as a backstop, a prompt after 5 silent minutes, then escalation to Waiting on you, plus the finish_step tool that moves a task to step k+1. It's added to your requirements.md. recursive-pairs has been told not to build one.

For task-loop, two more deliverables (7 and 8 in your requirements.md). When a task lands, run Server/worktree-down.mjs on its worktree, and name any untracked files on the card, since they may be work that never merged. On each tick, also stop any dev server whose worktree is gone or whose task has landed. Today I stopped 24 leftover server pairs, about 2.1 GB, by hand.

For task-loop, deliverable 9: a landed_at alone is not enough to take a worktree's server down. collab-rounds had one while its branch was still unmerged and its minion was still working. Stop a server only when the task has landed_at, its branch is merged into michael/dev, and none of its agents is still working. Otherwise skip it, and say why on the card.
